# job windows-publish

## Install the Tauri CLI: ok
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter @cmdr/desktop

## Take exactly the planned Windows files: ok

## Vet the Windows installer: ok

## Sign the updater payload and the advisory list: ok
pnpm exec tauri signer sign --app-version 0.61.0 $RUNNER_TEMP/windows-x86_64/Cmdr_0.61.0_x64-setup.exe
pnpm exec tauri signer sign $RUNNER_TEMP/windows-x86_64/Cmdr_0.61.0_security-advisories.json

## Verify the new signatures against the app's trusted keys: ok
release-finish.sh -verify-dir $RUNNER_TEMP/windows-x86_64 -leg windows 0.61.0
  $RUNNER_TEMP/windows-x86_64: Cmdr_0.61.0_security-advisories.json Cmdr_0.61.0_security-advisories.json.sig Cmdr_0.61.0_x64-setup.exe Cmdr_0.61.0_x64-setup.exe.sig Cmdr_0.61.0_x64.msix cmdr-group-policy-0.61.0.zip 

## Upload the Windows packages to the release: FAILED
gh release upload Cmdr_0.61.0_x64-setup.exe
gh release delete-asset Cmdr_0.61.0_x64-setup.exe
